about: Skills that people have found to be superseded by current frontier models. Matched by folder or frontmatter name. Send a PR to add one: say what the skill does and why a current model no longer needs it.

reason.zh: 要求每次对话都先去查找并调用技能，给所有任务加了一道门槛；现在的模型会自己判断何时需要技能
reason.en: Forces a skill lookup at the start of every conversation; current models decide on their own when a skill is needed

reason.zh: superpowers 工作流的一环（构思→计划→执行→分派）。前沿模型本身就会规划和拆分任务，固定流程反而拖慢简单任务
reason.en: Part of the superpowers ceremony (brainstorm, plan, execute, dispatch). Frontier models plan and split work themselves; the fixed ritual slows simple tasks

reason.zh: superpowers 的工程纪律提示（测试先行、系统排错、完成前验证）。这些已是前沿模型的默认做法
reason.en: superpowers discipline prompts (test first, debug systematically, verify before done). These are default behaviour for frontier models now

reason.zh: superpowers 的 Git 与代码评审流程提示。现在的编程智能体自带评审和分支管理能力
reason.en: superpowers git and review ceremony. Current coding agents ship their own review and branch handling

reason.zh: 教模型写技能的长篇指南。只在你自己写技能时有用，平时不必常驻
reason.en: Long guide on authoring skills. Only useful while you write skills yourself

reason.zh: 减少写代码常见错误的行为准则，前沿模型已经内化
reason.en: Behavioural guidelines against common coding mistakes, already internalised by frontier models

reason.zh: 针对早期模型“偷懒截断、用占位符”的问题。现在的模型没有这个毛病，强制全量输出反而让回答冗长
reason.en: Targets old models that truncated output or left placeholders. Current models do not, and forcing full output makes answers bloated

reason.zh: 会在会话结束时自动改写项目文档和记忆文件，可能和你自己的知识管理规则冲突
reason.en: Rewrites project docs and memory files at session end, which can clash with your own knowledge rules

reason.zh: 合写文档的流程引导。前沿模型不需要这套流程也能合写
reason.en: A guided co-writing workflow. Frontier models co-write fine without it

reason.zh: p5.js 生成艺术的示例与模板，前沿模型可以直接写
reason.en: p5.js generative-art examples; frontier models write these directly
